# data.docker_compose_config

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Renders a compose project the way `docker compose config` does, without the CLI and without contacting the daemon. The project is parsed, interpolated (only with `env` and `env_file`), merged and validated by compose-go; `compose_yaml` is the canonical YAML, `project` the same model as a structured object, and `content_sha256` detects change.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_go_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | compose-go version that loads, interpolates, merges and validates the project (v2.16.2, from go.mod). |
| `compose_spec_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Pinned compose-spec commit the structured fields follow (main @ 3a4a699...). |
| `compose_yaml` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Normalized compose config as `docker compose config` prints it: interpolated, include/extends resolved, merged, profiles applied. |
| `content` | `string` | optional |  |  | Compose YAML as a string. Exactly one of `content` and `files` must be set. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | Hex SHA-256 of `compose_yaml`. |
| `env` | `map(string)` | optional |  | yes | Variables for `${VAR}` interpolation. The provider's own environment is never read; values here override `env_file`. |
| `env_file` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Dotenv files read for interpolation variables (CLI `--env-file`), later files winning. |
| `files` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Compose file paths, merged in order like repeated `docker compose -f`. |
| `image_refs` | `map(string)` | computed |  |  | Map of service name to the image it runs after interpolation (`image`, or `<project>-<service>` for a build-only service). |
| `name` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | The compose project name (compose-spec top-level `name`, CLI `--project-name`). Defaults to the file's top-level `name`, then to the project directory's name. |
| `profiles` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Profiles to enable (CLI `--profile`). |
| `project` | `object` | computed |  |  | The whole normalized project (same shape as `project` on docker_compose). |
| `project_directory` | `string` | optional |  |  | The project directory relative paths resolve against (CLI `--project-directory`). Defaults to the first file's directory, or the Terraform working directory for `content`. |
| `service_names` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | The enabled services of the project, sorted. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_compose_config" "shop" {
  name              = "shop"
  project_directory = path.module
  env               = { WEB_TAG = "1.27-alpine" }
  content           = <<-EOT
    services:
      web:
        image: nginx:$${WEB_TAG}
  EOT
}

# The canonical YAML `docker compose config` would print, and one field of it.
output "compose_yaml" {
  value     = data.docker_compose_config.shop.compose_yaml
  sensitive = true
}

output "web_image" {
  value = data.docker_compose_config.shop.project.services["web"].image
}
```
